versions.changelog:
gocreative-llm 1.0.1

- Improved description to clarify support for AI text generation, model routing, and additional models (Claude, GPT, DeepSeek).
- Removed the obsolete skill-card.md file.

Initial release of GoCreative LLM Gateway — multi-model pay-per-call LLM API for agents.

- Access multiple LLM tiers (cheap, pro, ultra) via a single HTTPS endpoint.
- No API key, provider account, or monthly billing required; pay per call in USDC using x402.
- Select price/performance tier per request, routing to DeepSeek, Claude 4.5 Sonnet, or Claude Opus 4.6.
- Simple GET API: prompt is URL-encoded in the path; first call returns HTTP 402 for seamless wallet payment and retry.
- Integrates with GoCreative’s agent back-office tools for compliance, enrichment, and crypto.
